programme.desc: El enfrentamiento deja una "carnicería" frente al edificio donde el presidente de México da su discurso, pero el atentado fracasa. Víctor jura vengarse de Aurelio, pero ahora prepara el plan B.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Entre la confusión que reina en el convento, las Emes se identifican y entre Alba, Aurelio y sus hombres acaban con ellos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Detienen a Sebastián y ahora que él sabe quién es Rutila, Salazar lo utilizará para descubrir a Aurelio. Mónica insiste que Emiliana lo traicionará. Ismael quiere una alianza con su abuela.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los hombres que van a rescatar a la Felina comienzan a dispararle a la camioneta donde la trasladan y ella cree que Emiliana la traicionó. Se voltea la camioneta donde va la colombiana.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El presidente amenaza a Rivero con desacato o morir en el ejercicio de sus deberes, si no deja en paz a Aurelio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Doña Alba trata de interceder entre Mónica y Aurelio. Mónica toma una fuerte decisión que afecta a su hijo, Isidrito. Siguiendo sus sospechas, Alba se encuentra con un fantasma del pasado.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio queda con el corazón roto ante la verdad sobre Emiliana. Mientras, ella decide si enfrenta las consecuencias de sus actos o escapa.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ante la venganza y reaparición de Lourdes, Aurelio toma acciones drásticas. Mónica tiene un acercamiento lleno de emociones con Alba. Acorralan a Esperanza para actuar en contra de Aurelio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Esperanza explica el organigrama del narcotráfico en Colombia, México y Venezuela. Confirma al FBI que Casillas vive. Aurelio va a Colombia y se lleva una sorpresa. Alba enfrenta a Víctor.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Emiliana no le perdona a Casillas que matara a Lourdes. El cerco del FBI empieza a funcionar. Javi y Mónica son aliados.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los padres de Esperanza, Juan Carlos y Pina, están preocupados por su desaparición y sus presuntos vínculos con el narcotráfico. Ella, muerta de miedo, le pide a Salazar que no la abandone.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Colón garantiza la vida de Esperanza, como Marta Rangel. Ella le advierte sobre el Diablo que acaba de despertar. Javi visita a la Felina como aliado de Casillas. Dalvio sufre una emboscada.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Dalvio y Víctor se enfrentan con armas. Cansado, Dalvio enfrenta a Aurelio y se amenazan con pistolas. Colón traslada a Esperanza como testigo protegido a una casa de seguridad.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Se arma una balacera en casa de Rutila. Mónica escucha los planes de Víctor, sin que él se dé cuenta. Una noticia cambiará los planes de Eunice. Los padres de Esperanza pagan por encontrarla.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rafael le ofrece "merca" a Mónica a cambio de información sobre Casillas y ella saca las garras. Extraditan a Felina. Aurelio va tras Emiliana.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas está de cacería tras Emiliana. Amenaza con comérsela viva. Investigan el pasado de Rutila y aunque niega todo, cuando Castillo se va, ella se quiebra. Él está muy cerca de la verdad.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica se abre camino en México para hacer negocios a lo grande. El presidente la espera en Toluca y allí ventilan el pasado. Salazar desenreda el negocio de las metanfetaminas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Víctor pone una condición y es inflexible. Aurelio y sus hombres armados preparan el ataque contra él. Las cuatro toneladas de cocaína van rumbo a su destino. Mónica rechaza a Omar como hombre.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Se desata la balacera. Aurelio accionó el arma y su blanco fue Víctor, Casillas cree que lo mató. Todos se retiran, la Marina está por llegar. Tony Pastrana está a punto de ser excarcelado.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Omar decide ocultar información a la prensa. Rodrigo asegura a Salazar y a Colón que se quedará a su lado para destapar al narco presidente. Se entera de que Sebastián es un infiltrado.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio va a Cuba y se reúne con Penumbra para hacer negocios, pero no todo sale bien. Casillas amenaza con romper el tratado de paz. Víctor decide trabajar a escondidas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Nace la alianza entre Tony Pastrana y Mónica Robles. Ella jura vengarse de Aurelio cuando se levante, por haberle quitado a su hijo. El presidente pierde la compostura, al sentirse amenazado.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Esperanza explica el organigrama del narcotráfico en Colombia, México y Venezuela. Confirma al FBI que Casillas vive. Aurelio va a Colombia y se lleva una sorpresa. Alba enfrenta a Víctor.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Alondra exige terapia psicológica para su esposo Luis, quien está obsesionado con una famosa llamada Vampy. María pide que su madre le permita hablar con su padre, a quien daba por muerto.
programme.sub-title: El vampireso; 10 años sin ver a papá

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Cristina le exige 10 mil dólares a su esposo, Alejandro, por abuso sexual. Saúl intenta obligar a Alejandra a que le permita usar sus ahorros para que su suegra tenga una muerte asistida.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Daniela le dio a Juan un helado de viagra que lo volvió un pervertido; ahora él la demanda por 25 mil dólares. Teixeira exige que la amante de su esposo le dé las propiedades y joyas que él le regaló.
programme.sub-title: Helado de viagra; Las mujeres del gatillero

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Jorge y su amante quedaron enganchados como dos perritos y tuvieron que llamar a emergencias. Carmen se niega a devolverle la custodia de su hija a Aurora, alega que no está preparada.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Gabriela fue arrestada, humillada y despedida de su empleo porque Ricardo dio información personal sin permiso de ella. Un niño murió atropellado por su tío. La tragedia pesa sobre la familia.
programme.sub-title: Motel sin privacidad; Atropelló y mató a su sobrino

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Doris exige que le devuelvan la custodia de sus hijas; Carlos alega que ella tiene que curarse primero. Todos los beneficios de la esposa militar de Mariana se los dieron al exmarido.
programme.sub-title: Ni arrastrada voy al bootcamp; Viuda sin beneficios

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Una mujer utiliza la imagen de su hija como si la niña estuviera en huelga de hambre. En su testamento, un anciano aseguró que quien lo mate durante el sexo heredará todos sus bienes.
programme.sub-title: Niña huelga de hambre FB; Quien me mate hereda

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Natasha denuncia que Gabriel quiere convertir a su hijo pequeño en drag queen. Carmen exige congelar una cuenta de ahorros que le abrió a su hijo; él le quiere dar un uso distinto al dinero.
programme.sub-title: Educando para drag queen; Casi un niño pagando manutención

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El hijo de Manuel va a salir de la cárcel y él quiere desalojar a su nuera y quedarse con la custodia de su nieto. Un matrimonio está en crisis porque un cónyuge perdonó al asesino de su hija.
programme.sub-title: Que no salga mi hijo de la cárcel; Perdona al asesino de hija

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Luis es el dueño de una sala de banquetes en donde Estefanie fue grabada en secreto mientras estaba en el baño. A un bebé que nació con serios problemas médicos le dan poco tiempo de vida.
programme.sub-title: Banquet Hall caliente; Bebé corta vida

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Mientras practicaba juegos sexuales, a Santiago le introdujeron un teléfono celular en el recto. Ariel fue a la cárcel y le quitaron a su hijo; ahora que está libre lo quiere de regreso.
programme.sub-title: Celular techno sexual; Exconvicta exige custodia

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Mariana y Eduardo siempre quisieron ser padres, pero desde que ella quedó embarazada, se obsesionó con encontrar al donante de semen. Lilian exige ir a vivir con su madre a Puerto Rico, pero su padre no lo permite.
programme.sub-title: Amo al donante; Cannabis con mamá

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Sarah fue violada y torturada por abandonar el islam y convertirse al cristianismo. Camila está decepcionada de vivir en los Estados Unidos, quiere divorciarse y llevarse a su hija a Venezuela.
programme.sub-title: Torturada en Siria; A Venezuela con mi hija

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Sofía no puede permitir que la chica que fue su mejor amiga sea ahora la esposa de su padre. Marlon exige el divorcio de Salma y la custodia de su hijo. Salma no quiere divorciarse.
programme.sub-title: Amiga, ahora madrastra; Calientes y caritativos

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Mary adoptó al hijo de Mónica sin su consentimiento. Fernanda recibió 100 mil dólares cuando tenía 15 años; ahora, con 21, descubre que su madre y su hermano se han gastado casi todo el dinero.
programme.sub-title: El pasado de la frontera; Quiero mis $93 000 por violación

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Vino de Venezuela con su esposo y compraron una propiedad; a sus espaldas, él se casó con otra mujer y la metió a vivir en su casa. Cada vez que se enfurece, Orlando abusa físicamente de Eddie.
programme.sub-title: La casa de todos; Mal de rabia

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La melodía del serrucho vuelve loca a Maritza. Su marido le pide tratamiento psicológico. Gustavo exige la custodia de su sobrina sordomuda y que la madre de la pequeña desaloje la casa.
programme.sub-title: Mr. Black Serrucho; Niña sorda con tío

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Su nieta tiene un novio que mantiene una relación con otro hombre y a su madre le parece bien. Una mujer padece el síndrome del acaparador compulsivo y en su casa no se puede vivir.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Un padre le da hierbas a su hija de ocho años porque la vio tocarse, la madre está preocupada por la seguridad de su hija. Fátima es una cartera que fue despedida por estar embarazada.
programme.sub-title: Sin hambre no tendrá deseo sexual; Embarazada sin beneficio

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Por culpa de su marido, Ana perdió una pierna y a sus hijos; ahora pide el divorcio y la custodia de sus hijas. Alexis exige que Jorge se haga cargo de su mamá, la señora que trafica drogas.
programme.sub-title: Amputada y sin hijas; Mamá vende droga en hospital

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Nelson todavía sufre por las amenazas que recibió en Colombia. Carlos exige una orden de alejamiento para Ximena, quien quiere recuperar a su hija a pesar de que continúa metida en drogas.
programme.sub-title: Se mudan por amenaza de las Farc; Niña adoptada, madre drogadicta

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Nachi y Enrique son hermanos, conviven con una mujer y los dos están enamorados de ella. Javier exige que Carmen, la pareja de su padre, pague la deuda que dejó su progenitor antes de morir.
programme.sub-title: Todo queda en familia; Herencia mía, deuda tuya

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Liliana pagó 100 000 dólares por el rescate de Daniela, pero está convencida de que su hermana planificó el secuestro para estafarla.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Natasha exige la custodia de su hijo, Brend alega que la ama y que quiere seguir con ella. Un difunto le dejó la herencia a su exmujer, pero su actual esposa tiene un poder para quedarse con todo.
programme.sub-title: Ahora mujer para pastora; ¿Se valida el pre-nup o el testamento?

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Stephanie vino a vivir con su padre y quiere regresar a Venezuela porque él es alcohólico, vive en un tráiler y no se ocupa de ella. Además, tres hermanos se pelean por la herencia de su padre.
programme.sub-title: Quiero volver a Venezuela; Renuncio a la herencia

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Joaquín se lesionó cuando jugaba en el equipo de fútbol de su empresa. El dueño se niega a pagarle el sueldo mientras se recupera. José exige que el padre de su nieto se haga cargo del menor.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Claudia recibió una golpiza de una mujer que contrató Ignacio y exige que él le pague 200 000 dólares por daños y perjuicios. Una adolescente rebelde no quiere más castigos corporales de su padre.
programme.sub-title: Empresario en bancarrota; Disciplinando a su hija

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Liliana tiene un problema grave: su marido prefiere a su perra, hasta en la cama. Jean es un adolescente desesperado, su padre alcohólico lo desprecia, su única posibilidad es un tío tiránico.
programme.sub-title: Mi rival es una perra; Papá por favor quiéreme

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Luis tuvo una relación extramatrimonial y fue contagiado con una enfermedad venérea que le causó el divorcio. Lilian renta un cuarto a jóvenes, los seduce y los acusa de intento de violación.
programme.sub-title: Amante venérea; Roomate seduce por dinero

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Sara es modelo profesional y durante una sesión de fotos le destrozaron una nalga con un palo de golf. Vanessa es una travesti que se ha encariñado con un niño y ahora no lo quiere entregar.
programme.sub-title: Nalga ponchada; El travesti es la mamá

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Una madre busca obligar a su hija a que filme películas pornográficas con ella. Un joven diabético está enamorado de una chica menor de edad, ella quiere casarse con él, pero su madre lo prohíbe.
programme.sub-title: Obligada a hacer peli porno; Enamorado de un diabético

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Un viudo se excita con las cenizas de su difunta esposa para tener relaciones sexuales con su actual mujer. Victoria exige el divorcio a Roberto, quien es mago y desaparece el dinero que gana.
programme.sub-title: Enamorado de la muerta; La magia del adiós

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky calls the other Tubbies to come and watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story about the naughty sock. The Tubby Toast machine makes a tower of tubby toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children looking at penguins waddling and swimming. In Teletubbyland, the Tubbies play walk fast and slow, far and near and other different ways.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies play 'Boo', but stop to watch Ned help his dad plant and water some geraniums. In Teletubbyland, nine pretty flowers and a watering can appear.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies love playing on the slide. They stop to watch Andy Brown and some children digging in the sand for crabs.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Samira and her friends show the Teletubbies their gymnastic routines. The Teletubbies do their own gymnastics.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch Matthew and James help their uncle milk the cows. In Teletubbyland, the Tubby Custard machine isn't working, so they sing a special 'Tubby Custard' song. Then, the Tubby Custard machine works again.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet appears and the Teletubbies dance, before watching two girls do some Flamenco dancing with their teacher. It's time for the Teletubbies to wash their feet. They love using their Tubby Sponges.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies watch a little boy peel and mash some eggs for an egg mayonnaise sandwich. The Teletubbies laugh when they make a tune whilst eating their Tubby Custard.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies dance around the trees and watch some children drum with their friend Norris. Tinky Winky dance on the roof of Home Hill and wakes up the other Tubbies.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Dipsy says "Eh-oh" and runs off to find the other Tubbies. They watch some children make fantastic animals from papermache.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies watch a little girl who loves monkeys help her mum feed them in a zoo. Tinky Winky sits down to eat some Tubby Toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky says "Eh-oh". The Teletubbies and some children watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be the Funny Lady and tell the story of the naughty hat. The Teletubbies are very happy when they find their favourite things to play with.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: In Teletubbyland, the Tubbies are trying to be quiet. They watch Oscar read the story of the Gingerbread Boy to his brother Felix. A voice trumpet appears and sings the nursery rhyme.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Po fetches the other to watch Andy Brown and two children look for some rabbits. In Teletubbyland, Tinky Winky is looking for Po. He looks for her everywhere, but she is hiding from him. When he finds her all the Tubbies dance a happy dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies dance an up and down dance. They watch some children painting pictures and patterns on to eggs. In Teletubbyland, Laa-Laa dances with her ball until the magical tree appears.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa sit down to eat some Tubby Custard. Po wants some too. She tries to eat the other's Tubby Custard, but they won't let her.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch a little boy show us how to make a Turban. The Tubbies go for a walk, but Po, Laa-Laa and Dipsy want to play with their favourite things.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises and teaches the Teletubbies a nursery rhyme. Then they watch Becky go for a ride on a Tram. Po rides her scooter too fast and knocks the other Tubbies over.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies watch some children are playing football in the park. Laa-Laa and Po love playing with the ball. While they play they sing a song about the ball.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies pop up from behind a hill to watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story of the naughty sausage. Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Po go for a walk, so Laa-Laa decides to dance a secret dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies want to go to sleep, but Tinky Winky finds Po already asleep in his bed. So he goes to look for somewhere else to sleep.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number three. Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa go for a walk. They count three trees and three flowers and Po follows behind counting too.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are asleep when a voice trumpet appears singing the rhyme 'Frére Jacques'. The Teletubbies laugh and call "Again, again!"

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch two boys make Chinese Lanterns with their uncle. In Teletubbyland, it is time for Tubby Toast, but where has Laa-Laa's toast gone?

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises and makes the Teletubbies laugh. They watch some children exploring the colour green. The Teletubbies love green.

programme.desc: The Teletubbies and some children learn about the colour blue. In Teletubbyland Po is watching the blue sky when it begins to rain.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Noo-Noo tidies up Home hill before the Teletubbies slide up the slide to watch Natalie tell us about her brother's christening.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch Sarah and Mark give their sheep a winter-feed. In Teletubbyland, the Teletubbies cannot decide whether to have Tubby Custard or Tubby Toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies leave their favourite things to watch some boys spinning some spinning tops to celebrate the Hanukah festival. Tinky Winky wears the skirt on his head to do a very special round and round dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies dance a jumping dance before stopping to watch Yvette wash up her plastic cups and saucers. The Teletubbies have a very messy day. So Noo-Noo has to tidy everything up.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are asleep, but Noo-Noo tidies up their blankets. They stop chasing him to watch some children learn about the number five. A flashing light appears in Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children making Christmas cards. Laa-Laa's present is some lovely decorations. When Noo-Noo tidies them up they tickle his throat, so he throws them out to decorate Home Hill.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Two children are making Christmas crackers for each other. Dipsy is very pleased to find his present is a cracker. He looks for someone to pull the cracker. It makes a lovely pink bang and the Teletubbies laugh when they fall over.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A group of children sing some Christmas carols to the Teletubbies. Tinky Winky opens his present to find a beautiful star inside. The Teletubbies follow it all over Teletubbyland, but where will is end up?

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet appears and teaches the Teletubbies a winter nursery rhyme. Po's present is a little frosty cloud that begins to snow. All the Teletubbies laugh as they play in the snow.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Alex Pascall and some children sing to their dolls to rock them to sleep. Laa-Laa wants to sing a lovely song, but Tinky Winky is crunching his Tubby Toast too loudly!

programme.desc: The Teletubbies march up and down a hill and then they watch some children explore the colour pink. Tinky Winky doesn't know how to make Tubby Custard.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Laa-Laa dances with her ball. A little boy tells us why he likes to live in his block of flats. A balloon appears in Teletubbyland. The Teletubbies follow a balloon.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies giggle as they play their 'Through the Arch' game. The windmill stops them to watch a little girl and her dad go for a walk in the town.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies line up to say 'Eh-oh' and then watch Matthew and Mark feed a baby calf. The Teletubbies play a game to see who can eat their Tubby Custard the slowest, but Po can't wait and eats her Tubby Custard very fast.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Jennifer and Norman Rice buy a historic mansion in Garden Grove, Iowa, but renovations uncover eerie rumors of a buried body. As the paranormal activity intensifies, Jennifer and their son are tormented while Norman is away. When he returns, he too falls victim to the evil force. Even the church's blessing fails, forcing the family to flee their dream home before it destroys them.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Teenager Nolan Lydolph has seen ghosts all his life, but after a ghost tour in Branson, MO, his family's Iowa farmhouse becomes plagued by sinister shadows. When attacks turn violent, Nolan and his mother call paranormal investigator Wesley Fox. He and his psychic wife uncover a calculating demon targeting Nolan, forcing him into a life-threatening battle for survival.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: When Phil Pritchard's beloved father dies, he falls into a deep depression that renders him vulnerable to an unearthly evil that begins influencing him and will stop at nothing to render him a pawn in its relentless thirst for misery and murder.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Michigan attorney Chris Gibbons and his family move into their dream house, which quickly becomes a nightmare. A bizarre combination of terrifying dreams and ghost sightings force Chris to do battle with the supernatural.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: In Springfield, Illinois, the Lake Club was once a lively dance hall where fortunes were won and lost. In 1974, Bill and Tom transform it into a rock club and soon uncover eerie secrets. Phantom music and chilling cold spots make them believe they are not alone. Others share their fears, and a young woman receives a ghostly warning: one of the owners is about to die.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Childhood fear is pure, untempered by adult rationality. After his divorce, Steven LaChance dismisses his children's nightmares as stress-until he experiences chilling disturbances himself. Shadows lurk, screams echo, and an unseen force preys on them. He flees, but when another family moves in, he vows to help them. If you enter the spirit world, the spirits enter yours.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: When Sidney's girlfriend moves in, he and his mother, Jaime, experience disturbing events, escalating from eerie calls to physical attacks. They soon discover an ex-friend is using witchcraft to tear them apart. As Jaime becomes the target of a deadly assault, the family, fearing for their lives, seeks the help of paranormal investigators before the dark forces succeed in their sinister plan.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: After Candace and John St. Clair visit a haunted tunnel where slaves were buried alive, something follows them home. Their daughter has terrifying nightmares, dishes shatter, and the entity soon turns violent. Attacked and terrified, they call paranormal experts to cleanse their home-before they're forced to flee from the malevolent presence.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: In 2012, Amanda Morrisson and her family clean a relative's home to fund his care but uncover satanic objects. Soon, they face terrifying events-Nate sees shadows, David has nightmares, and Alliah spirals into depression. When Amanda encounters a sinister entity, they seek a demonologist, who traces the haunting to an evil necklace David took from the house.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator Stacy Jones feels confident letting her son Jamie join her at a cemetery investigation. But after returning home, Jamie finds strange scratches on his leg and experiences terrifying activity-objects flying and unseen forces attacking him. When Stacy witnesses a demonic assault on her son, she calls in expert John Zaffis to help save Jamie from possession.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: In 2012, Olivia and Jesse Barbour's daughter Marie befriends a boy named Jackson-who isn't real. At first harmless, Jackson soon frightens Marie, leaving bruises and urging her to follow him to heaven. When she's found with red marks on her neck, the family seeks help. Investigators reveal Jackson is a cruel spirit-an old man disguised as a boy to torment Marie.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: While preparing their late friend Paul's house for sale, Anita Intenzo and her son Chris encounter his spirit-along with something much darker. When a violent entity attacks Chris, Anita seeks help. A medium warns of a demon linked to a mysterious artifact Paul acquired abroad. As chaos erupts in their home, Anita and Chris must locate the artifact before the demon destroys them.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Latin jazz guitarist Eddie Benitez moves to Arizona to revive his career, but his home is haunted. Strange occurrences escalate when his son falls mysteriously ill. With no medical explanation, Eddie discovers the room was the site of a horrific suicide. Fearing the spirit is slowly killing his son, Eddie turns to his Puerto Rican roots to battle the deadly entity before it's too late.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: The Fahey family has lived in their Galway townhouse for decades. When Martha brings home her newborn, eerie disturbances begin. Unexplained cries echo through the night, objects vanish, and a chilling presence fills the house. A priest offers no relief, but a healer reveals a dark secret-Martha's child has awakened the psychic energy of a long-buried crime that prayer alone cannot erase.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: After rejecting a friend's advances, Stephanie Winters is cursed. Soon, in their new Virginia home, she and her husband experience strange noises and objects moving. When the entity violently scratches and chokes Stephanie, they seek help. A paranormal investigator suspects a demonic ritual, leading them to a demonologist and the church to battle the dark force before it destroys Stephanie.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: North Carolina natives Jamie and Aaron live a 'perfect' Southern lifestyle until a dark entity begins communicating with and terrifying their children. The family risks ridicule by neighbors and family when they call paranormal experts to the rescue.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Modern science suggests we are all connected by energy. This may explain why Romie feels drawn to an abandoned house in Tucson, Arizona. After moving in, nightmares bleed into reality, and she sees a shadowy spirit. A clairvoyant urges her to communicate with it, but fear holds her back. As the entity targets only her, Romie begins to question her sanity-is the house haunted, or is she cursed?

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Jennifer Hoke and fiancé Jamie Jones find their dream home in Pensacola, FL, but something dark lurks within. Strange noises and shadows soon escalate to violent attacks. Jamie is pulled from bed, and the family is trapped in terror. Seeking answers, they turn to a local empath, who uncovers a history more sinister than they ever imagined.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: John Drenner Jr. unknowingly unleashes a demon after finding a satanic bible in an abandoned shack. Plagued by violent attacks and nightmares, he spirals into depression. Just as the entity threatens to claim his life, he finds hope in a young woman who helps him seek deliverance. With time running out, exorcist Bill Bean must act fast to drive out the demon before it's too late.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Taylor Jones reconnects with her estranged mother, Joyce, unaware of the darkness she brings. When Taylor finds Joyce practicing black magic in her daughter's room, she cuts ties-but it may be too late. Isabelle soon has an invisible friend, then grows terrified to be alone. As the haunting escalates, a paranormal team uncovers a tragic past in the attic, trapping tormented souls forever.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: It's said that every photograph steals a piece of a soul. What happens when the subject is dead? Lisa becomes obsessed with a photo of her boyfriend's brother, killed in Vietnam. As her fixation deepens, she experiences waking visions of the soldier and believes the picture has a life of its own. When her daughters report supernatural encounters, Lisa realizes the spirit is taking control.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Sam Baltrusis' séance performance leaves him possessed and desperate for safety. A Shaman battles the spirit, so Sam can regain control of his life.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Mark Corvo rents out rooms in his childhood home, dismissing strange noises as quirks of an old house. But when a tenant, Ashley, dabbles in dark arts, sinister activity intensifies. A paranormal team confirms a portal has been opened. Mark, an empath, is targeted by dark forces and nearly dies after being pushed from his roof. After recovering, he learns to manage his gift and protect his home.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: When ghosts confront Zoe Dei, she makes the harrowing discovery that her home harbors a paranormal portal which has awakened her dormant ability as psychic medium, forcing her to learn how to live with her newfound ability to see the dead.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: In life, people can be tormented by their own crimes. The same may be true in death. In Wilder, Kentucky, a nightclub stands by the Licking River, said to draw murderers and Satanists. Club owner Bobby Mackey dismisses the legends-until his wife and an employee are attacked by unseen forces. Beneath the club, an old slaughterhouse well harbors an ancient evil, waiting to claim its next victims.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: After James Hilton and his girlfriend Sandy bring an antique cabinet into their home, they capture actual video evidence proving it's haunted. Sandy fears the entity from the cabinet is taking James over and turns to paranormal investigators for aid.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Kim and Craig settle into their dream home in Bagley, Iowa, but eerie encounters shake their peace. Kim senses an intruder, and her daughter befriends a strange man-one no one else can see. When the unseen entity turns violent, a paranormal investigator confirms the presence of a vengeful spirit. Desperate to protect their family, they turn to a demonologist to drive out the ghost.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Newlyweds Bill and Myrisa Spencer move into a renovated apartment, eager for a fresh start. But ghostly figures soon roam the halls, and their dream home turns into a nightmare. Unable to break their lease, they endure the hauntings-until a violent attack on Bill forces them to seek help. With local ghost hunters, they uncover the building's dark past and the entities that still linger.
